# Ian Pontorno — Full-Stack Developer & Growth Engineer

Ian Franco Collada Pontorno is a Full-Stack Developer & Growth Engineer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He builds web and desktop applications, automation tools, and data workflows.

His background spans software development, IT operations, and performance marketing. He currently works at Fanger Design in paid media and automation.

## Focus

- Web and desktop product development
- Data workflows and process automation
- Applied AI and local semantic search
- Backend services, persistence, and delivery
- Paid media, tracking, and growth systems

## Selected projects

- MIM — Desktop and web platform for Minecraft modpack management, deterministic crash diagnostics, static bytecode inspection, NBT recovery, and cloud collaboration. https://github.com/Ian9Franco/MIM
- Elseframe Comics — Interactive comic reader and creative authoring platform. https://github.com/Ian9Franco/ElseframeComics
- Smart Scan — Private local file explorer project focused on semantic search and multimedia workflows.
- Plotter — Film discovery and review platform. https://github.com/Ian9Franco/plotter
- Web-Sling Optimizer — Browser-based image optimization tools for product catalogs. https://github.com/Ian9Franco/Web-Sling-Optimizer

- IT Operations & Automation Specialist, Codere — 2019 to 2025
